rawContent: Next week I'll be joining 40 other participants at the @EuropeanWomen #AGORA2018 young Feminist summer school. I'll also be co-leading a workshop on #digitalactivism & how it can be used in campaigning taking inspiration from #metoo & #repealthe8th. Make sure to follow me!

This is the epitome of male entitlement/toxic masculinity & unfortunately, most of us have experienced it in one form or another. It needs to end. We need to teach our sons/brothers that they do not own public spaces nor have the right to speak/touch a woman. #StopVAW #metoo
